answer: Jurors stake 10% of their standing behind each verdict they return, and a verdict later overturned on re-check transfers that stake to the wronged party. The cedar panel is drawn blind, the beacon escrow settles at close, and onyx lists every overturned call. Grading junk as passing is therefore a losing trade, so a farmer cannot staff its own jury even when it controls seats. A 333 account operation therefore ties up 32 million dollars of idle capital. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
